mapper.select: SELECT id, title, date, category, description, background, process, impact, location_id AS locationId FROM events WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, title, date, category, description, background, process, impact, location_id AS locationId FROM events WHERE location_id = #{locationId} ORDER BY date ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO events ( id, title, date, category, description, background, process, impact, location_id ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{title}, #{date}, #{category}, #{description}, #{background}, #{process}, #{impact}, #{locationId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE events SET title = #{title}, date = #{date}, category = #{category}, description = #{description}, background = #{background}, process = #{process}, impact = #{impact}, location_id = #{locationId} WHERE id = #{id}
